recipe.visualDefinition: A centered medium-shot portrait of a man in a blue shirt and light blue scarf, set against a rugged coastal cliffside under a deep blue twilight sky. The composition features high-contrast serif text aligned to the top corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a diagonal cliff line
Deep blue sky occupying the upper half of the frame
White serif text balanced in the top left and right corners
Cool-toned color palette with warm skin tones as a focal point
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused lighting on the subject's face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the vertical space in a medium shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the light blue scarf provide the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, moves upward to the text in the corners, and follows the diagonal line of the cliff back down.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space is provided by the expansive blue sky in the upper third.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue (sky and shirt) establishes a calm, cool atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (text) provides high legibility and a clean finish.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light blue (scarf) and earthy browns (cliff) add texture and variety.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the landscape with higher value contrast between the subject and the dark cliffside.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both title and artist name to maintain symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and elegant serifs of the original.
Provides the necessary vertical stress and thin hairlines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s-style film photograph of a man with brown hair wearing a blue button-down shirt and a light blue scarf. He is standing in front of a steep, rocky coastal cliff. The sky above is a deep, solid blue twilight. The lighting should be soft on the subject but high contrast against the dark cliff.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add title text in the top left corner and artist name in the top right corner using a white Didone serif font like Bodoni. Ensure the text is small and elegant with tight tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the text placed in the top corners?
Is the font a high-contrast serif?
Does the sky occupy the top third of the image?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text overlap with the subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered outdoor portrait with a diagonal landscape element and symmetrical corner-aligned Didone typography for a classic 70s singer-songwriter aesthetic.
